description: For infinite \(\kappa\), nonempty \(\kappa\)-saturated structures \(M,N\) with \(|M|,|N|\le\kappa\), and a specified partial elementary map \(f:A\to N\) with \(|A|<\kappa\), there is an isomorphism \(e:M\cong N\) satisfying \(e(a)=f(a)\) for every \(a\in A\). In particular, taking \(N=M\) gives the automorphism-extension assertion.
